title: Top 10 Lies I Revealed as a Pastor

top_liked.author: @Eyesopeningheartrealigning
top_liked.text: You took time to heal and become a better human being that has a powerful message and naturally creates connections and community, thank you for coming back and helping us see reality!

top_liked.author: @Thefriendlydruid

By definition you can't lie to someone and not realise it.
The act of lying requires intent to mislead, if you think what you're saying is true then you aren't lying regardless of if you're actually right or not.
